headword: {反復横跳|はんぷくよことび}び

definitions.explanation: A fitness-test exercise in which the participant rapidly jumps sideways between marked lines on the floor, commonly used in Japanese schools to measure agility and quickness.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{反復|はんぷく}→反復：11096_hanpuku⟧ (repetition) + ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (side) + {跳|と}び (jumping). A specific fitness-test exercise where the participant stands over a center line and jumps sideways to touch lines 100 cm on either side, repeating as many times as possible within a set time (usually 20 seconds).
